posts.title: Pixels of the Week – November 8, 2026
posts.description: This week we explore if AI could make the open web disappear, if a dialog should close on outside click (plot twist: it depends), and we tag along flights in the sky. And don’t miss the fun pigeon armchair and portraits of people who dress alike.

posts.title: Pixels of the Week – November 1, 2026
posts.description: This week sadly explores how buying online became a nightmare, from deceptive patterns to AI slop. Also, don't miss a fun history guessing game, colorful tufting art, and a book on feminist approaches to type, and my Golden Honey Suckle color.

posts.title: Pixels of the Week – October 25, 2026
posts.description: This week we explore the “disability dongle” problem, ecommerce accessibility issues that get customers stuck, and the double-edged sword of AI-generated prototypes. Also, don’t miss some horror graphic novels for Halloween and a gaming database for parents!
